import FormalConjecturesUtil
import FormalConjectures.Wikipedia.Hadamard

/-!
# The circulant Hadamard conjecture

A circulant matrix is generated by cyclically shifting one row. The circulant Hadamard conjecture,
also attributed to Ryser, says that no circulant Hadamard matrix has order greater than $4$.

*Reference:*
* S. Steinerberger,
  [A note on approximate Hadamard matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.13202)
-/

namespace CirculantHadamard

/-- A generator for a circulant Hadamard matrix of order four. -/
def orderFourGenerator : Fin 4 → ℝ :=
  ![1, 1, 1, -1]

/-- The order-four generator gives a circulant Hadamard matrix. -/
@[category test, AMS 15]
theorem orderFourGenerator_isHadamard :
    Hadamard.IsHadamard' (Matrix.circulant orderFourGenerator) := by
  constructor
  · intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      norm_num [Matrix.circulant, orderFourGenerator, Fin.sub_def, Fin.neg_def]
  · ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      norm_num [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.circulant, orderFourGenerator, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
        Fin.sub_def, Fin.neg_def, Matrix.ofNat_apply]

/-- Every circulant Hadamard matrix has order at most four. -/
@[category research open, AMS 15]
theorem circulant_hadamard_conjecture {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hv : Hadamard.IsHadamard' (Matrix.circulant v)) : n ≤ 4 := by
  sorry

end CirculantHadamard

reformulations.difference: The source defines Hadamard matrices using orthogonal rows and asserts nonexistence for n > 4. Lean uses the column Gram identity MᵀM = nI and concludes n ≤ 4, allowing all natural n, including zero.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: The transpose of a circulant is circulant, and real circulant matrices commute, so MᵀM = MMᵀ. Since all entries are ±1, each row has squared norm n; consequently the Gram identity is equivalent to pairwise orthogonality of the rows. The universal order bound is equivalent to nonexistence above order four. The additional n = 0 case imposes no restriction because 0 ≤ 4. The predicate equivalence and the full conjecture-statement equivalence were proved in /workspace/review/scratch.lean without invoking the open conjecture.

https://arxiv.org/e-print/2402.13202 — v1 LaTeX source, especially §1.1 (Hadamard definition and Ryser conjecture), §1.3 (circulant convention), and §3 (remarks and quantitative variants).

review.notes: Checked all three declarations. The order-four generator produces a cyclic row permutation of the paper’s example, and its existing proof has no sorry dependency. The scratch file compiles without errors or warnings; it checks orders zero and one, excludes the zero generator in positive dimensions, and exhaustively tests integer ±1 generators through order nine. The consulted sources continue to record the conjecture as open.
